compose_transforms: build a Compose pipeline to apply multiple transforms sequentially on a results dictionary
keymapper_remap_keys: build a KeyMapper to map outer data keys to inner transform keys and remap outputs
broadcast_transforms: build a TransformBroadcaster to apply the same transforms to multiple images with shared random params
random_choice_pipeline: build a RandomChoice wrapper to randomly select and apply one of several transform pipelines
random_apply_transform: build a RandomApply wrapper to apply a transform with a given probability
